name: Man And Wife
overview: Scripture reveals that the union of man and wife is divinely ordained, beginning with God’s declaration that it is not good for man to be alone, prompting the creation of a suitable helper (Genesis 2:18). This union is characterized by leaving one's parents and cleaving to one's spouse to become one flesh (Genesis 2:24), a bond that God Himself joins and forbids man to separate (Matthew 19:6). The Bible highlights the value and blessing of finding a wife, describing her as a virtuous woman whose worth is beyond rubies and as a source of favor from the Lord (Proverbs 18:22; 31:10). Within this covenant relationship, wives are called to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, reflecting the order and reverence God intends in marriage (Ephesians 5:22).
